:::{#exr-log-partition-normalization}
#### The exponential of the log-partition function is a normalizing integral

Let $\Rvar$ be a [continuous random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-continuous-rv)
whose [density](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pdf) has the form of @eq-exponential-family.
Use the fact that a density integrates to one
to show that

$$
\expf{\logpartitionf{\natparam}}
= \int \basemeasuref{\rvar} \, \expf{\natparam \, \statf{\rvar}} \, d\rvar.
$$

For a [discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv),
replace the [integral](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures-integrals.html#def-integral)
with a [sum](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-sums.html#def-summation) over the possible values.

:::
